title: ENS name registrations on Ethereum
tagline: Every .eth registration and renewal, from the ENS v1 controller's launch in March 2023 to the ENSv2 ETHRegistrar today: about 1.5 million events you can query with plain SQL or from your AI agent, without paging eth_getLogs.

queries.title: Latest registrations
queries.sql: SELECT to_timestamp(block_timestamp) AS at, name, owner, ens_version FROM registrations ORDER BY block_number DESC, tx_hash DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Longest names registered this week
queries.sql: SELECT substr(name, 1, 40) AS name, length(name) AS len, to_timestamp(block_timestamp) AS at FROM registrations WHERE block_timestamp > epoch(now()) - 7*86400 ORDER BY len DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Names containing 'ai' registered in the last 24 hours
queries.sql: SELECT name, to_timestamp(block_timestamp) AS at, owner FROM registrations WHERE name LIKE '%ai%' AND block_timestamp > epoch(now()) - 86400 ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Top registrants by names registered, all time
queries.sql: SELECT owner, count(*) AS names FROM registrations GROUP BY owner ORDER BY names DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Registrations per day, last 14 days
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(to_timestamp(block_timestamp) AS DATE) AS day, count(*) AS registrations FROM registrations WHERE block_timestamp > epoch(now()) - 14*86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

queries.title: Registrations per year, v1 and v2 together
queries.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM to_timestamp(block_timestamp)) AS year, count(*) AS registrations FROM registrations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prompts: Using the registrations view, which 5 names containing 'ai' were registered most recently, and who registered each? Show the registration time in UTC.
Which 10 addresses have registered the most .eth names ever (view registrations), and how many does each hold?
How many .eth names were registered per day over the last 14 days (view registrations)? Which day was busiest, and how does the ENS v2 era compare to the last days of v1?
